Download the Steam installer.
Run the installer and start the installation process.
Follow on-screen instructions to complete installation.
Wait until installation finishes.
Launch the Steam application.
Observe for any installation errors or issues.
testScenarios.passFailCriteria:
Steam should download and install successfully.
Application should launch without errors.
No installation failures, crashes, or interruptions should occur.

testScenarios.objective: Verify that the Blizzard (Battle.net) platform is installed successfully without issues
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
Navigate to the official Blizzard website.
Download the Battle.net installer.
Run the installer and initiate the installation process.
Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the installation.
Wait for the installation to finish.
Launch the Battle.net application.
Observe for any installation errors or issues.
testScenarios.passFailCriteria:
Battle.net should download and install successfully.
Application should launch without errors.
No installation failures, crashes, or interruptions should occur.

testScenarios.objective: Verify that the Epic Games Launcher is installed successfully without issues
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
Navigate to the official Epic Games website.
Click on “Get Epic Games”.
Download the Epic Games Launcher installer.
Run the installer and start the installation process.
Follow on-screen instructions to complete installation.
Wait for the installation to finish.
testScenarios.passFailCriteria:
Epic Games Launcher should download and install successfully.
Application should launch without errors.
No installation failures, crashes, or interruptions should occur.

testScenarios.objective: Epic Games Launcher is installed and ready for use.
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
Launch the Steam application.
Navigate to the Library section.
Select an installed game.
Click on the Play button.
Wait for the game to launch.
Observe the game startup behavior.
Verify that the game reaches the main screen or initial load.
Check for any errors, crashes, or launch failures.
testScenarios.passFailCriteria:
The game should launch successfully without errors.
No crashes, freezes, or launch failures should occur.
Game should reach a playable or startable state (no need to test performance).

testScenarios.objective: Verify that the installed game from Blizzard (Battle.net) launches and runs without issues
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
Launch the Battle.net application.
Navigate to the Games/Library section.
Select an installed game.
Click on the Play button.
Wait for the game to launch.
Observe the game startup behavior.
Verify that the game reaches the main screen or initial load.
Check for any errors, crashes, or launch failures.
testScenarios.passFailCriteria:
The game should launch successfully without errors.
No crashes, freezes, or launch failures should occur.
Game should reach a runnable/startable state (no need to validate performance).

testScenarios.objective: Verify that the installed game from Epic Games launches and runs without issues
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
Launch the Epic Games Launcher.
Navigate to the Library section.
Select an installed game.
Click on the Launch/Play button.
Wait for the game to start.
Observe the game startup behavior.
testScenarios.passFailCriteria:
The game should launch successfully without errors.
No crashes, freezes, or launch failures should occur.
Game should reach a runnable/startable state (no need to evaluate performance).
